profiles.name: Wan Hassan Mohd Ramli
profiles.description: Wan Hassan Mohd Ramli represents Dungun, Terengganu, in the Dewan Rakyat. A PAS member.

milestones.title: Run subsidised basic-goods sales for Dungun residents
milestones.description: Wan Hassan described service-centre cheap-sales programmes and cooperation with the state’s Pasar Berkat.
milestones.progress_note: The interview records the service centre covering part of goods costs. This is a March 2025 activity snapshot, not an audited cost-of-living impact result. Later programme coverage and completion remain unverified.
